_about: ONE place for every number and requirement the editor uses (rebuild 2026-11-10, OB: 'no more mistakes'). The gate (qc_route.py), ob_job.py, the audio pickers, the reviewer checklist and the skill's route files all read this file. Prose may explain a value; it never restates one. Change a value here, with OB's words and the date in its _why.

enforce._why: Stage switch. Jobs started with ob_job.py are always strict. Files with no job (older engines, other tabs mid-edit) deliver the old way until legacy_until, then deliver.py refuses them.

paths._why: The T7 filled up on 11-06 and again on 11-10. Work never goes there. Deliveries go to the first root with room and the full path is always printed.

music.edu_tone: upbeat, bright, confident, major key; never ambient, drone, film score, sneaky or curious jazz, emotional piano, lo-fi chill
music._why: OB 11-07 'turn the background music down' (27 LU, stem vs stem), 'Education content should be upbeat and higher enegery', 'You always go so depressing', 'You have a bank of so many choices'; M57 never reuse another video's bed; candidates: AUDIT-AUDIO 5B

sfx._why: OB 10-16 'have different sound effects and make them a little quieter because it gets so repetitive'; 10-29 'use them when needed dont be obxious'; 11-06 'I also hated that sound effect you used' (Kenney ticks, glitch); 11-07 'use the sound effects from the bank first before making your own always'; sync window ITU-R BT.1359

picture._why: OB 11-07 'its zooming in and out non stop'; 'Why is it so fidgety'; 11-06/11-09 cutouts (BiRefNet only); M38 no black backgrounds; M09 no flashes; flash rate ITU-R BT.1702; 11-06 upscaled backgrounds 'glitchy'

text._why: M05, M11, M12; brand 'Athletic' picked by OB 10-28 ('these bubble text scream ai editing'); Meta ad safe zone for anything boosted (CRAFT-RESEARCH D3)

assets._why: OB 11-07 'y do you always show me fat asf as toned and shredded'; M21 consent; M22/M28 no AI imagery, voice or music in videos; M16 'you just put text... not even a photo' (7 repeats); M23

delivery._why: OB 11-03 'just one after editing now'; 11-04 'only 1 is needed'. The voice+SFX stem stays in WORK so the bed can be swapped in a minute.

records._why: A pick with one candidate is the fastest route (AUDIT-MISTAKES cause F, 16 repeats). Each record below must exist in WORK and pass before delivery.

warn_policy._why: WARNs went out unread on 427-575 of 630 deliveries. 'answer' = each WARN needs a line in qc/warn_answers.json; 'info' = noise that never blocks.
